title: EDCT-Bench: Uncovering Faithfulness Gaps in VLMs via Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing
abstract: arXiv:2609.17953v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can produce Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) that sound plausible yet remain inconsistent with the visual evidence they cite. We present Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing (EDCT), an intervention-based protocol that extracts visual concepts cited in a model's explanation, applies verified minimal edits to them, and tests whether the resulting answer and explanation remain consistent with the edited image. Using this protocol, we create EDCT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning three complementary domains: knowledge-intensive visual question answering (OK-VQA), safety-critical driving (DriveLM), and 3D spatial reasoning (3DSRBench). Across the evaluated VLMs, EDCT reveals substantial faithfulness gaps, with models frequently producing responses inconsistent with verified visual changes. translated_title: EDCT-Bench：通过解释驱动的反事实测试揭示视觉语言模型中的忠实性差距
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够生成听起来合理、却与其所引用的视觉证据不一致的自然语言解释（NLE）。我们提出了EDCT，这是一种基于干预的测试协议：它提取模型解释中所引用的视觉概念，对这些概念施加经过验证的最小编辑，并检验由此产生的答案和解释是否仍与编辑后的图像保持一致。利用该协议，我们构建了EDCT-Bench，这是一个覆盖三个互补领域的综合性基准：知识密集型视觉问答（OK-VQA）、安全关键驾驶（DriveLM）以及3D空间推理（3DSRBench）。在所评估的多个VLM上，EDCT揭示了显著的忠实性差距，模型经常产生与经过验证的视觉变化不一致的回答。最后，我们的微调研究表明，EDCT生成的反事实样本能够提供高影响力的训练数据。
tldr: 提出了一种基于干预的解释驱动反事实测试方法EDCT，通过对模型解释中引用的视觉概念进行经验证的最小编辑来系统评估VLM解释的忠实性，并据此构建了覆盖三个领域的基准EDCT-Bench，揭示了现有VLM中普遍存在的显著忠实性差距。
en_tdlr: Proposes EDCT, an intervention-based protocol that applies verified minimal edits to visual concepts cited in a model's explanation to systematically evaluate VLM explanation faithfulness, and builds EDCT-Bench spanning three domains, revealing substantial faithfulness gaps in existing VLMs.
